name: python-on-path
label: Python 3
description: Python 3 is runnable — as python3 or python on Unix, as py -3 or python on Windows.

commands.darwin: for c in python3 python; do v=$($c --version 2>&1) && case "$v" in "Python 3"*) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 1
commands.linux: for c in python3 python; do v=$($c --version 2>&1) && case "$v" in "Python 3"*) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 1
commands.win32: $env:Path += ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); foreach ($c in @('py','python')) { if (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $a = @(); if ($c -eq 'py') { $a = @('-3') }; $v = & $c @a --version 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and "$v" -match '^Python 3') { exit 0 } } }; exit 1
